FIELDS.NAME: GreenThumb Landscaping Services
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
GreenThumb Landscaping Services specializes in providing high-quality residential and commercial lawn care and landscaping services. Our core operations include design, planting, and routine maintenance of gardens and lawns, ensuring that each project enhances the natural beauty of our clients' properties. We emphasize the use of sustainable practices and work closely with licensed nurseries and reputable material suppliers to source our plants and landscaping materials. Our team is trained in safe landscaping techniques, and we maintain strong relationships with our clients through clear communication and detailed contracts. While we offer incidental tree trimming as part of our services, we do not focus on tree removal, as we prefer to limit the associated risks. Additionally, our approach to pest management involves the careful and certified application of pesticides and herbicides only when necessary. We prioritize safety and quality, ensuring a dedicated focus on customer satisfaction and environmental responsibility.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in tree trimming and removal as a primary activity, nor does it apply pesticides and herbicides outside of incidental landscaping services, ensuring all applications are conducted by properly certified personnel. Additionally, we do not pursue large maintenance contracts focused on municipal or institutional clients, and we affirm that our contents do not exceed $500,000, eliminating the need for a central alarm system.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On June 10, 2022, a minor injury occurred during a landscaping project when a crew member accidentally cut themselves while trimming hedges. The medical expenses totaled $800. This incident has been resolved, with all related costs covered by our Workers' Compensation insurance.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 3:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Fire safe, Class 2, Grade B, UL listed.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central alarm system and perimeter fencing around the property.
